This requires a higher-fidelity execution engine capable of discrete combinatorial sampling.",

Method: Uniform grid of 8x8 points covering the range. Evaluate all 64 points using TMM. Select the best performing point. Report thicknesses and full reflectance spectrum. Seed: 17.",

    "thickness_error_model": "absolute_normal",

    "angle_perturbation_deg": 0.0,
